Beyond the Cup

Jaggery Powder is Your
Everyday Sugar Alternative

Wherever you use refined sugar, Uchit Yum works better. It dissolves in hot and cold, adds natural depth of flavour, and fits every part of your day — for the whole family.

☕
Chai, Coffee & Hot Drinks

Replace sugar in your morning cup with one 5gm sachet. Dissolves instantly in hot liquids, adding a warm, rich sweetness that white sugar simply can't match.

1 sachet = 1 perfect cup
🥤
Cold Drinks, Shakes & Lassi

Dissolves in cold water too. Add it to nimbu pani, shikanjvi, mango lassi, cold coffee or iced teas for natural sweetness — no artificial aftertaste, ever.

Cold-soluble · Crystal clear
🥛
Kids' Milk & Haldi Doodh

Make milk naturally tasty for children. Stir into haldi doodh, badam milk, or plain warm milk. A traditional way to sweeten without refined sugar — kids love it.

Kid-safe · No chemicals
🍪
Baking — Cakes, Cookies & Ladoos

Swap sugar 1:1 in baking. Jaggery powder adds deep caramel flavour and golden colour to cakes, cookies, chikkis and traditional sweets like ladoos and halwa.

1:1 sugar swap in recipes
🍲
Dals, Sabzis & Marinades

Traditional Indian cooking uses jaggery to balance flavours in dal tadka, tamarind chutney, tomato gravies and marinades. The powder form makes it effortless.

Traditional flavour balancing
🧃
Smoothies, Juices & Pre-Workout

Fitness-conscious consumers are switching to jaggery powder in smoothie bowls, fresh juices and pre-workout drinks. Natural energy, clean fuel, zero guilt.

Our Process

Farm to Sachet

Every sachet tells the story of patience, tradition and care — from the sugarcane field to your cup.

🌾
Stage 01
The Fields

Sugarcane grown in rich Indian soil, harvested at peak maturity when sweetness is fullest.

🔥
Stage 02
Slow Heating

Fresh cane juice slow-heated in iron pans using time-honoured methods. No shortcuts, no chemicals.

✨
Stage 03
Natural Solidification

The thick golden juice cools into jaggery — rich and caramel-like — without bleaching or sulphur.

⚙️
Stage 04
Powder Conversion

Jaggery blocks crushed into smooth, free-flowing powder — consistent colour, perfect for any use.

📦
Stage 05
5gm Packaging

Precision-filled, hygienically sealed sachets — ready for every cup, every recipe, every occasion.

"From every farm, to every cup." 🍵
